question: Should per-job/heartbeat elevated exec be solved as a narrow elevated marker, or folded into the broader Gateway-owned scheduling provenance model?
rationale: The remaining work changes host-exec authority and upgrade behavior, so automation should not pick the permanent trust model without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Fold into provenance design
options.body: Use this issue as the elevated-exec slice of the broader non-forgeable schedule and execution provenance model, with heartbeat covered explicitly.

options.title: Implement narrow elevated markers
options.body: Add per-job and heartbeat elevated authority fields now, but still require explicit create/update/execution audit semantics and migration proof.

options.title: Keep wildcard model temporarily
options.body: Defer implementation and document the current wildcard risk while preserving existing trusted unattended workflows.
